landing.title: Report civic problems. Follow them until they are fixed.
landing.intro: Potholes, garbage, waterlogging, road damage and more: send a photo from the spot and CivicBrain helps the council check, plan and fix it.
landing.step1Title: Take a photo at the spot
landing.step1Text: Use the in-app camera. Your location is added automatically.
landing.step2Text: AI checks the photo, finds duplicates and suggests a priority. An officer makes every decision.
landing.step3Title: Track it until it is fixed
landing.step3Text: Get e-mail and WhatsApp updates at every step, then confirm the fix.
landing.limits: AI estimates of size and cost are preliminary. Wards are analytical GIS units, not the electoral wards.

camera.intro: Take the photo at the spot with the in-app camera. Your location is added automatically.
camera.guide: Fit the problem inside the frame
camera.a4Tip: Optional: place an A4 sheet next to it, it helps to estimate the size.
camera.tiltAdjust: Tilt the phone down about 45 to 70 degrees
camera.tiltLevel: Hold the phone level (do not turn it sideways)
camera.gpsPoor: Move to open sky and retry. Location within {{meters}} m, 150 m or better is needed.
camera.gpsDeniedText: CivicBrain needs your location to send the complaint to the right ward. Allow location for this site in your browser settings (the lock or settings icon next to the address), then tap Retry location.
camera.gpsUnavailable: Your location could not be found. Turn on location (GPS) on your phone and retry.
camera.gpsUnsupported: This browser cannot share your location. Please use Chrome or Safari on your phone.
camera.fallbackTitle: The camera could not be opened
camera.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings and try again, or take the photo with your phone camera below.
camera.cameraMissing: No camera was found on this device. Take the photo with your phone camera below.
camera.cameraBusy: The camera is used by another app. Close it and try again, or take the photo with your phone camera below.
camera.cameraInsecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) address. Take the photo with your phone camera below.
camera.cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot open the camera inside the page. Take the photo with your phone camera below.
camera.fallbackButton: Take a photo with the phone camera
camera.captureFailed: The photo could not be taken. Please try again.
